bitfield.description: Clear output priv attribute. If each bit is set then the outgoing priv bit is cleared, else the bit is unchanged. Do not set both priv and nopriv for the same bit. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n

Make outgoing non-secure. A value of 1 forces secure clear, others do nothing. Do not set both sec and nonsec. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Make outgoing secure. A value of 0xA forces secure set, others do nothing. Do not set both sec and nonsec. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Priv ID value to use if pass is 0. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Default region indication. The default region is used when all other regions do not match. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Enable channel mode to match region to a chanid value. Otherwise use address mode to match region to an address range. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Lock region. Once set, the region values cannot be modified. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Enable region. A value of 0xA enables, others disable. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
